1: # BK7258 OpenVela AP移植
2: 
3: 本项目将OpenVela/NuttX移植到BK7258 AP核，并保留博通原厂CP固件、Bootloader、分区和最终打包流程。当前已实现AP核启动，以及AP日志通过Mailbox转发到CP UART0输出。
4: 
5: ## 简单使用说明
6: 
7: 本项目需要配合博通`bk_avdk_smp` SMP工程使用：
8: 
9: ```text
10: 工作区/
11: ├── contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/
12: └── bk_avdk_smp/
13: ```
14: 
15: 构建前，需要使用比赛仓中已验证的完整文件覆盖`bk_avdk_smp`原文件：
16: 
17: ```text
18: external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c
19:   -> bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c
20: 
21: external/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
22:   -> bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
23: ```
24: 
25: 从工作区根目录执行：
26: 
27: ```bash
28: cp \
29:   "contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/external/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c" \
30:   "bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c"

34:   "bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv"
35: ```
36: 
37: 覆盖前请备份原文件。详细OpenVela构建、CP构建和最终固件打包步骤见`github开发指南.md`及`external/bk_avdk_smp/README.md`。
38: 
39: ## 主要目录
40: 
41: ```text
42: board/beken/chips/bk7258/                  BK7258 AP启动、中断、定时器和Mailbox驱动
43: board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/       BK7258 AP板级配置、链接脚本和bring-up
44: external/bk_avdk_smp/                      已验证的博通CP覆盖文件
45: logs/                                      AI Coding日志
46: ```
47: 
48: ## 已实现功能
49: 
50: - BK7258物理CPU1/AP启动OpenVela/NuttX。
51: - Cortex-M33启动向量、C运行时、MPU、FPU、IRQ和SysTick基础适配。
52: - Mailbox v2基础传输、logical channel、sequence、ACK、超时和FIFO full恢复。
53: - AP power-up indication、2秒heartbeat和PWC boot-ready握手。
54: - AP日志通过Mailbox UART0转发到CP物理UART0。
55: - GPIO40红灯和GPIO41绿灯由NuttX内核自动LED状态接口接管，用于显示
56:   中断、信号、断言、Panic、空闲和启动状态。
57: - AP、CP和Bootloader通过`bk_avdk_smp`标准打包流程生成`all-app.bin`。
58: - 当前为CPU1单核bring-up，CPU2/AP SMP尚未启用。

62: # contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing
63: 
64: 👋 欢迎参加 **2026 首届 openvela AI 硬件开发者大赛**！

66: 这是组委会为你的队伍创建的**专属参赛仓库**（本仓为样例/模板，队伍编号 `264`；你看到的将是你自己的 `contest2026_<编号>_<队伍名>`）。比赛期间，你的全部参赛代码、打包产物与 AI Coding 日志都提交到这里。

106: ## 三、第二步：在哪里写代码
107: 
108: **只在自己的仓目录 `contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/` 里开发。** 不同作品形态放在对应子目录，manifest 会通过 `<linkfile>` 把它们**软链**到 openvela 编译树该在的位置——你不用手动 copy：

113: | 快应用   | `quickapp/hello_quickapp/` | `packages/apps/contest2026_264_hello_quickapp` |
114: | 板级适配 | `board/contest_board/`     | `vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_264_board` |
115: 
116: > 用不到的形态目录可以删掉；新增作品时按同样规则加子目录，并在 `contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing.xml` 里补一条 `<linkfile>` 映射即可。**生产仓库（packages/nuttx/vendor 等）零改动。**

100: ## 3. 正确构建链条
101: 
102: 最终固件链条固定为：
103: 
104: ```text
105: OpenVela nuttx.bin
106:   -> bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
107:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN
108:   -> package/tmp/app1.bin
109:   -> package/all-app.bin
110: 
111: Armino CP app.bin + Beken bootloader.bin
112:   ---------------------------------------> package/all-app.bin
113: ```
114: 
115: 修改以下任一输入后，不得直接做 SMP 增量构建：
116: 
117: - `ram_regions.csv`
118: - AP/CP `config`
119: - Kconfig 默认值
120: - 分区生成脚本
121: - SoC 链接脚本
122: 
123: 原因是顶层 `partitions/ram_regions.h` 可以先更新，而 AP/CP CMake 构建目录中的
124: `armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv`、生成头和预处理链接脚本仍可能保留旧值。
125: 这会形成顶层 16 MiB、核内仍 8 MiB 的不一致产物。
126: 
127: 先构建 OpenVela AP，并将输入放到 SMP 工作树：
128: 
129: ```bash
130: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
131: ./build.sh \
132:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
133:   -e -Werror --cmake -j8
134: 
135: cp \
136:   cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
137:   ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/openvela-ap.bin
138: ```
139: 
140: 然后执行项目级 clean 和容器内完整构建：
141: 
142: ```bash
143: cd ~/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp
144: make -C projects/app_ab clean
145: 
146: podman run --rm \
147:   --userns=keep-id \
148:   -v "$PWD:/armino" \
149:   -w /armino \
150:   localhost/bekencorp/armino-idk:1.5 \
151:   make -C projects/app_ab bk7258 \
152:   SDK_DIR=/armino \
153:   EXTERNAL_AP_BIN=/armino/build/openvela-ap.bin
154: ```
155: 
156: `make -C projects/app_ab clean`只删除`projects/app_ab/build`，不会删除
157: `build/openvela-ap.bin`。仅安装 Podman 时不要使用内部调用 Docker 的`dbuild.sh`。
158: 
159: ## 4. 构建验收
160: 
161: 以下文件必须都反映同一份 16 MiB 布局：
162: 
163: ```text
164: projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
165: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/partitions/ram_regions.h
166: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv
167: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv
168: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/armino/bk7258/bk7258_out.ld
169: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/armino/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_out.ld
170: ```
171: 
172: 关键值应为：
173: 
174: ```text
175: CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY          0x01000000
176: CP_PSRAM_HEAP                 0x60700000 + 0x00020000
177: AP_PSRAM_HEAP                 0x60720000 + 0x002e0000
178: AP_PSRAM_SECTION              0x60a00000 + 0x00600000
179: PSRAM 最终边界                0x61000000
180: ```
181: 
182: 外部 AP 输入和最终打包输入必须完全一致：
183: 
184: ```bash
185: sha256sum \
186:   ~/vela_competition/contest/cmake_out/bk7258-ap_nsh/nuttx.bin \
187:   build/openvela-ap.bin \
188:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
189: 
190: cmp -s \
191:   build/openvela-ap.bin \
192:   projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/tmp/app1.bin
193: ```
194: 
195: 检查最终产物：
196: 
197: ```text
198: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/all-app.bin
199: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/app_ab_crc.rbl
200: projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/package/build_summary.txt
201: ```
202: 
203: `build_summary.txt`中的 AP 内存统计来自 Armino AP 占位镜像，只用于检查生成的
204: 内存区域边界；它不代表最终打包的 OpenVela AP 静态占用。OpenVela AP 的静态
205: 内存应以 `nuttx.map`或`System.map`为准。
206: 
207: ## 5. OpenVela PSRAM 接入状态
208: 
209: OpenVela AP侧已经完成以下代码和离线构建基线：
210: 
211: - 精确16 MiB、RW/XN/non-cacheable MPU映射。
212: - `0x60720000..0x609fffff`独立AP PSRAM heap。
213: - USER/AUDIO/ENCODE/DISPLAY四个独立媒体pool。
214: - 明确排除`0x60700000..0x6071ffff` CP heap的地址检查。
215: - AP owner区域保存/恢复型alias probe，包含4/8/12 MiB测试点。
216: - 当前SMP协议兼容的`0x7/0x8/0x9/0xa`PWC处理和PSRAM_REQUIRED ready门禁。
217: - `0x60a00000..0x60ffffff`静态section链接保留；reset copy/clear未实现前强制0 B。
218: 
219: 当前CP协议不通过`0xc`或其他命令暴露PSRAM initialized、device ID和actual capacity。
220: `0x7`响应只回显ON/OFF状态，不能单独证明PHY初始化成功或器件为16 MiB。因此当前
221: alias probe是临时运行时门禁，不能替代CP status协议扩展和整颗器件实板测试。

26: #define MB_WORK_INTERVAL       MSEC2TICK(10)

31: enum ack_slot_state
32: {
33:   ACK_SLOT_FREE = 0,
34:   ACK_SLOT_QUEUED,

38: struct logical_channel
39: {
40:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message pending;
41:   bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback;
42:   void *arg;
43:   int result;
44:   bool queued;

47: struct active_transaction
48: {
49:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message __attribute__((aligned(32)));
50:   bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback;

60: {

67: {

69:   struct active_transaction probe;
70:   uint32_t reset_order;
71:   uint32_t first_probe_order;

73:   bool replay;

77: {
78:   uint32_t tx;
79:   uint32_t rx;

81:   uint32_t timeout;

103: static struct logical_channel g_channels[MB_CHANNEL_COUNT];

130:                "at least three stable recovery epochs are required");

132: static struct recovery_epoch *current_recovery(void)
133: {
134:   return &g_recovery[g_recovery_index];
135: }

137: static unsigned int channel_index(uint8_t channel)
138: {
139:   unsigned int i;
140: 
141:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
142:     {
143:       if (g_channel_ids[i] == channel)
144:         {
145:           return i;
146:         }
147:     }
148:

152: static unsigned int ack_slots_used(void)
153: {
154:   unsigned int count = 0;
155:   unsigned int i;
156: 
157:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
158:     {
159:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_FREE)
160:         {
161:           count++;
162:         }
163:     }
164: 
165:   return count;
166: }

168: static struct active_transaction *busy_probe(void)
169: {
170:   unsigned int i;
171: 
172:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
173:     {
174:       if (g_recovery[i].probe.busy)
175:         {
176:           return &g_recovery[i].probe;

183: static int send_slot(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
184:                      uint32_t *order)
185: {
186:   uint32_t wire[2];
187:   int ret;
188: 
189:   wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)message;
190:   wire[1] = sizeof(*message);
191:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
192:   ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
193:   if (ret == OK)
194:     {
195:       *order = ++g_send_order;
196:       g_stats.tx++;
197:     }
198:   else if (ret == -EAGAIN)
199:     {
200:       g_stats.fifo_full++;
201:     }
202: 
203:   return ret;
204: }
205: 
206: static void release_acks_before(uint32_t order)
207: {
208:   unsigned int i;
209: 
210:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
211:     {
212:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_SENT &&
213:           g_ack_slots[i].order < order)
214:         {
215:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
216:         }
217:     }
218: }

220: static void set_link_state(enum bk7258_mb_link_state state)
221: {
222:   if (g_link_state != state)
223:     {
224:       if (state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
225:         {
226:           g_stats.link_ready++;
227:         }
228:       else if (state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN)
229:         {
230:           g_stats.link_down++;
231:           g_down_since = clock_systime_ticks();
232:         }
233: 
234:       g_link_state = state;
235:       nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
236:       g_diag_state = state;
237:       nxsem_post(&g_diag_sem);
238:     }
239: }

241: static void complete_transaction(struct active_transaction *active,
242:                                  const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
243:                                  int result)
244: {
245:   struct logical_channel *channel = NULL;
246: 
247:   if (active->channel_index < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
248:     {
249:       channel = &g_channels[active->channel_index];
250:       channel->queued = false;
251:       channel->result = result;
252:     }
253: 
254:   if (active->callback != NULL)
255:     {
256:       active->callback(ack, result, active->arg);
257:     }
258: 
259:   active->busy = false;
260:   if (result == OK)
261:     {
262:       release_acks_before(active->order);
263:     }
264: }
265: 
266: static void fail_pending(int result)
267: {
268:   unsigned int i;
269: 
270:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
271:     {
272:       struct logical_channel *channel = &g_channels[i];
273: 
274:       if (channel->queued)
275:         {
276:           channel->queued = false;
277:           channel->result = result;
278:           if (channel->callback != NULL)
279:             {
280:               channel->callback(NULL, result, channel->arg);
281:             }
282:         }
283:     }
284: }

286: static void release_recovery_slots(void)
287: {
288:   unsigned int i;
289: 
290:   g_active.quarantine = false;
291:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
292:     {
293:       memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
294:     }
295: }
296: 
297: static void select_recovery_epoch(void)
298: {
299:   unsigned int i;
300:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = NULL;
301: 
302:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
303:     {
304:       if (!g_recovery[i].probe.quarantine &&
305:           !g_recovery[i].reset_sent && !g_recovery[i].probe.busy)
306:         {
307:           epoch = &g_recovery[i];
308:           g_recovery_index = i;
309:           break;
310:         }
311:     }
312: 
313:   if (epoch == NULL)
314:     {
315:       uint32_t newest = 0;
316: 
317:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
318:         {
319:           if (g_recovery[i].probe.order >= newest)
320:             {
321:               newest = g_recovery[i].probe.order;
322:               epoch = &g_recovery[i];
323:               g_recovery_index = i;
324:             }
325:         }
326: 
327:       epoch->replay = true;
328:       g_stats.recovery_replay++;
329:     }
330:   else
331:     {
332:       memset(epoch, 0, sizeof(*epoch));
333:       epoch->reset.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
334:         0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
335:         BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
336:     }
337: 
338:   g_probe_attempts = 0;
339:   g_reset_pending = !epoch->replay;
340:   g_stats.recovery_cycle++;
341:   set_link_state(epoch->replay ? BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING :
342:                                  BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
343: }
344: 
345: static void begin_abort(int result)
346: {
347:   struct active_transaction *probe = busy_probe();
348: 
349:   if (g_active.busy)
350:     {
351:       g_active.quarantine = true;
352:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
353:     }
354: 
355:   if (probe != NULL)
356:     {
357:       probe->quarantine = true;
358:       complete_transaction(probe, NULL, result);
359:     }
360: 
361:   fail_pending(result);
362:   g_probe_requested = false;
363:   select_recovery_epoch();
364: }

366: static struct ack_slot *alloc_ack_slot(void)
367: {
368:   unsigned int i;
369: 
370:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
371:     {
372:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state == ACK_SLOT_FREE)
373:         {
374:           g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_QUEUED;
375:           return &g_ack_slots[i];
376:         }
377:     }
378: 
379:   g_stats.ack_overflow++;
380:   return NULL;
381: }
382: 
383: static int dispatch_locked(void)
384: {
385:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
386:   struct active_transaction *active;
387:   struct logical_channel *channel;
388:   unsigned int i;
389:   int ret;
390: 
391:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
392: 
393:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
394:     {
395:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
396:         {
397:           continue;
398:         }
399: 
400:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
401:       if (ret < 0)
402:         {
403:           return ret;
404:         }
405: 
406:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
407:     }
408: 
409:   if (g_reset_pending)
410:     {
411:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
412:       if (ret < 0)
413:         {
414:           return ret;
415:         }
416: 
417:       g_reset_pending = false;
418:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
419:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
420:     }
421: 
422:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
423:     {
424:       return OK;
425:     }
426: 
427:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
428:     {
429:       channel = &g_channels[i];
430:       if (!channel->queued)
431:         {
432:           continue;
433:         }
434: 
435:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
436:         {
437:           if (g_channel_ids[i] != BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX ||
438:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) !=
439:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
440:             {
441:               continue;
442:             }
443: 
444:           active = &epoch->probe;
445:           if (active->quarantine && !epoch->replay)
446:             {
447:               return -ENOLINK;
448:             }
449:         }
450:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
451:         {
452:           active = &g_active;
453:           if (active->quarantine)
454:             {
455:               return -ENOLINK;
456:             }
457:         }
458:       else
459:         {
460:           return OK;
461:         }
462: 
463:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
464:         {
465:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
466:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
467:                  sizeof(active->message));
468:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
469:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
470:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
471:             g_channel_ids[i]);
472:         }
473: 
474:       active->callback = channel->callback;
475:       active->arg = channel->arg;
476:       active->channel_index = i;
477:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
478:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
479:       if (ret < 0)
480:         {
481:           return ret;
482:         }
483: 
484:       active->busy = true;
485:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
486:         {
487:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
488:             {
489:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
490:             }
491: 
492:           g_probe_attempts++;
493:           g_stats.probes++;
494:         }
495: 
496:       return OK;
497:     }
498: 
499:   return OK;
500: }
501: 
502: static bool valid_ack_header(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
503:                              const struct active_transaction *active)
504: {
505:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
506: 
507:   return active->busy && control == BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX &&
508:          bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) ==
509:            bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message) &&
510:          bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) ==
511:            bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message) &&
512:          bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) ==
513:            bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message);
514: }
515: 
516: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
517: {
518:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
519:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
520:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
521: }
522: 
523: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
524: {
525:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
526:   struct active_transaction *active;
527:   bool replay;
528:   int result;
529: 
530:   active = busy_probe();
531:   if (active == NULL)
532:     {
533:       active = &g_active;
534:     }
535: 
536:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))
537:     {
538:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
539:       return;
540:     }
541: 
542:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
543:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
544:     {
545:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
546: 
547:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
548:       return;
549:     }
550: 
551:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
552:     {
553:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
554:       return;
555:     }
556: 
557:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
558:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
559: 
560:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
561:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
562:     {
563:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
564:     }
565: 
566:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
567:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
568:   if (replay)
569:     {
570:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
571:       unsigned int i;
572: 
573:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
574:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
575:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
576:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
577:        */
578: 
579:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
580:       g_active.quarantine = false;
581:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
582:         {
583:           if (i != replay_index)
584:             {
585:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
586:             }
587:         }
588: 
589:       select_recovery_epoch();
590:       (void)dispatch_locked();
591:       return;
592:     }
593: 
594:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
595: 
596:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
597:     {
598:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
599:         {
600:           release_recovery_slots();
601:           g_recovery_index = 0;
602:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
603:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
604:         }
605:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
606:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
607:         {
608:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
609:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
610:            */
611:         }
612:       else
613:         {
614:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
615:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
616:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
617:         }
618:     }
619: 
620:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
621:            result < 0)
622:     {
623:       begin_abort(result);
624:     }
625: 
626:   (void)dispatch_locked();
627: }
628: 
629: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
630: {
631:   struct ack_slot *slot;
632:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
633:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
634:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
635:   uint8_t state = 0;
636:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
637: 
638:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
639:     {
640:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
641:       if (slot == NULL)
642:         {
643:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
644:           return -EAGAIN;
645:         }
646:     }
647:   else
648:     {
649:       slot = NULL;
650:     }
651: 
652:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
653:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
654:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
655:     {
656:       g_stats.bad_header++;
657:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
658:     }
659:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_RX && g_uart_rx != NULL)
660:     {
661:       ret = g_uart_rx(message, &ack_flags, g_uart_rx_arg);
662:       if (ret < 0)
663:         {
664:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
665:         }
666:     }
667:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
668:     {
669:       g_pwc_rx(message);
670:       ret = OK;
671:     }
672:   else
673:     {
674:       g_stats.unsupported++;
675:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
676:     }
677: 
678:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
679:     {
680:       return OK;
681:     }
682: 
683:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
684:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
685:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
686:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
687:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
688: 
689:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
690:     {
691:       g_probe_requested = true;
692:     }
693: 
694:   (void)dispatch_locked();
695:   return OK;
696: }
697: 
698: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
699: {
700:   irqstate_t flags;
701:   uint8_t control;
702: 
703:   flags = up_irq_save();
704:   g_stats.rx++;
705:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
706: 
707:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
708:     {
709:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
710:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
711:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
712:         {
713:           g_stats.bad_header++;
714:         }
715:       else
716:         {
717:           g_stats.resets++;
718:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
719:         }
720:     }
721:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
722:     {
723:       handle_ack(message);
724:     }
725:   else

751:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;

769:                  reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,

782: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
783: {
784:   (void)argc;
785:   (void)argv;
786: 
787:   for (;;)
788:     {
789:       struct active_transaction *probe;
790:       irqstate_t flags;
791:       bool request_probe;
792: 
793:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
794:       flags = up_irq_save();
795: 
796:       probe = busy_probe();
797:       if ((g_active.busy &&
798:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
799:           (probe != NULL &&
800:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
801:         {
802:           g_stats.timeout++;
803:           if (probe != NULL)
804:             {
805:               probe->quarantine = true;
806:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
807:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
808:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
809:             }
810:           else
811:             {
812:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
813:             }
814:         }
815: 
816:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
817:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
818:         {
819:           select_recovery_epoch();
820:         }
821: 
822:       (void)dispatch_locked();
823:       if (g_probe_requested && ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
824:         {
825:           g_probe_requested = false;
826:         }
827: 
828:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
829:                       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
830:                       !g_channels[2].queued && !g_active.busy;
831:       if (request_probe)
832:         {
833:           g_probe_requested = false;
834:         }
835: 
836:       up_irq_restore(flags);
837: 
838:       if (request_probe)
839:         {
840:           bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
841:         }
842:     }
843: 
844:   return OK;
845: }

908: int bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(uint8_t logical_channel,
909:                              const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
910:                              bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback, void *arg)
911: {
912:   struct logical_channel *channel;
913:   unsigned int index;
914:   irqstate_t flags;
915:   int ret;
916: 
917:   if (!g_initialized || !g_physical_started || message == NULL)
918:     {
919:       return -EAGAIN;
920:     }
921: 
922:   index = channel_index(logical_channel);
923:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
924:     {
925:       return -EINVAL;
926:     }
927: 
928:   flags = up_irq_save();
929:   channel = &g_channels[index];
930:   if (channel->queued)
931:     {
932:       up_irq_restore(flags);
933:       return -EBUSY;
934:     }
935: 
936:   if (g_link_state != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
937:       !(g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
938:         logical_channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
939:         bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE))
940:     {
941:       up_irq_restore(flags);
942:       return -ENOLINK;
943:     }
944: 
945:   if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY && g_active.quarantine)
946:     {
947:       up_irq_restore(flags);
948:       return -ENOLINK;
949:     }
950: 
951:   memset(&channel->pending, 0, sizeof(channel->pending));
952:   memcpy(&channel->pending, message, sizeof(channel->pending));
953:   channel->callback = callback;
954:   channel->arg = arg;
955:   channel->result = -EINPROGRESS;
956:   channel->queued = true;
957:   ret = dispatch_locked();
958:   if (ret < 0 && ret != -EAGAIN)
959:     {
960:       channel->queued = false;
961:       channel->result = ret;
962:     }
963: 
964:   up_irq_restore(flags);
965:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
966:   return ret == -EAGAIN ? OK : ret;
967: }

1103: {

1105:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);

1119:       queued = g_channels[index].queued;
1120:       result = g_channels[index].result;
1121:       up_irq_restore(flags);
1122:       if (!queued)
1123:         {
1124:           return result == -EINPROGRESS ? OK : result;
1125:         }
1126:

154: static u8 cal_crc8_0x31(u8 *data_buf, u16 len)
155: {
156: 	u8    crc = 0x00;
157: 
158: #if MB_UART_CRC8_ENABLE
159: 	for (u16 i = 0; i < len; i++)
160: 	{
161: 		crc = crc8_table[crc ^ data_buf[i]];
162: 	}
163: #endif
164: 
165: 	return (crc);
166: }

204: static bool mb_uart_validate_command(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb,
205: 				     mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd, bool data)
206: {
207: 	if (uart_cmd->resvd || uart_cmd->mb_cmd.param3)
208: 		return false;
209: 
210: 	if (data)
211: 	{
212: 		if (uart_cmd->cmd_buff != chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff ||
213: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len < 1 ||
214: 			uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > UART_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
215: 			return false;
216: 		return uart_cmd->crc8 == cal_crc8_0x31((u8 *)uart_cmd->cmd_buff,
217: 							 uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
218: 	}
219: 
220: 	return uart_cmd->cmd_buff == NULL && uart_cmd->cmd_data_len == 0 &&
221: 		uart_cmd->crc8 == 0;
222: }

224: static void rx_isr_data_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t * uart_cmd)
225: {
226: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
227: 
228: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, free_cnt;
229: 
230: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
231: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
232: 
233: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
234: 	{
235: 		free_cnt = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
236: 	}
237: 	else
238: 	{
239: 		free_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
240: 	}
241: 
242: 	if(!mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, true))
243: 	{
244: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
245: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
246: 		tx_fail = 1;
247: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
248: 	}
249: 
250: 	if(uart_cmd->cmd_data_len > free_cnt)
251: 	{
252: 		chnl_cb->status_overflow = 1;   /* discards all rx-data.  */
253: 		tx_fail = 1;
254: 		
255: 		goto rx_isr_data_xit;
256: 	}
257: 
258: 	#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
259: 	flush_dcache(uart_cmd->cmd_buff, uart_cmd->cmd_data_len);
260: 	#endif
261: 
262: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
263: 
264: 	cpy_len = uart_cmd->cmd_data_len;
265: 
266: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
267: 	{
268: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
269: 		chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
270: 	}
271: 	else
272: 	{
273: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - wr_idx;
274: 
275: 		if(rd_idx == 0)
276: 			rem_len -= 1;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
277: 
278: 		if(rem_len > cpy_len)
279: 		{
280: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, cpy_len);
281: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx += cpy_len;
282: 		}
283: 		else
284: 		{
285: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf + wr_idx, uart_cmd->cmd_buff, rem_len);
286: 
287: 			if(rem_len < cpy_len)
288: 			{
289: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rx_buf, uart_cmd->cmd_buff + rem_len, cpy_len - rem_len);
290: 			}
291: 
292: 			chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx = cpy_len - rem_len;
293: 		}
294: 	}
295: 
296: 	free_cnt -= cpy_len;
297: 
298: 	if(chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback != NULL)
299: 	{
300: 		chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->rx_isr_param);
301: 	}
302: 
303: rx_isr_data_xit:
304: 	
305: 	if(free_cnt <= MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN)
306: 	{
307: 		chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 1;
308: 	}
309: 
310: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
311: 
312: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
313: 
314: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
315: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
316: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
317: 	 */
318: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
319: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
320: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
321: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
322: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
323: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = tx_fail;
324: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
325: 
326: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
327: 	{
328: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
329: 		{
330: 			/* trigger send! */
331: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
332: 		}
333: 	}
334: 	
335: 	return;
336: }

338: static void rx_isr_state_handler(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_uart_cmd_t *uart_cmd)
339: {
340: 	u8      old_cts = chnl_cb->status_cts;
341: 	u8 cmd = uart_cmd->chnl_hdr.cmd;
342: 	u8 invalid = !mb_uart_validate_command(chnl_cb, uart_cmd, false);
343: 
344: 	if (!invalid)
345: 		chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_cmd->uart_rts;
346: 	else
347: 	{
348: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
349: 		chnl_cb->bad_command_count++;
350: 	}
351: 
352: 	/* overwrite the uart_cmd after the ISR handle completed.
353: 	 * return the rsp info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
354: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
355: 	 */
356: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)uart_cmd;
357: 	memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
358: 	uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
359: 	uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
360: 	uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = invalid;
361: 	uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
362: 
363: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != old_cts)
364: 	{
365: 		if(chnl_cb->status_cts == 0)
366: 		{
367: 			/* trigger send! */
368: 			mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
369: 		}
370: 	}
371: 
372: 	return;
373: }

375: static void mb_uart_rx_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
376: {
377: 	/* The response carries the current RTS state, but it cannot replace an
378: 	 * outstanding ACK-pool fence.
379: 	 */
380: 	if (!chnl_cb->tx_fence_req)
381: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
382: 	
383: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
384: 	{
385: 		rx_isr_data_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
386: 	}
387: 	else if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
388: 	{
389: 		rx_isr_state_handler(chnl_cb, (mb_uart_cmd_t *)cmd_buf);
390: 	}
391: 	else
392: 	{
393: 		/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle completed.
394: 		 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
395: 		 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
396: 		 */
397: 		mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)cmd_buf;
398: 		u8 cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
399: 		memset(uart_rsp, 0, sizeof(*uart_rsp));
400: 		uart_rsp->chnl_hdr.cmd = cmd;
401: 		uart_rsp->uart_rts = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
402: 		uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail = 1;
403: 		uart_rsp->resvd = 0;
404: 	}
405: 	
406: 	return;
407: }

409: static void mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
410: {
411: 	mb_uart_rsp_t * uart_rsp = (mb_uart_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
412: 
413: 	u8      tx_fail = 0;
414: 
415: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == uart_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
416: 
417: 	if ((ack_buf->hdr.cmd != chnl_cb->tx_cmd) ||
418: 		(chnl_cb->tx_in_process == 0) )
419: 	{
420: 		chnl_cb->bad_ack_count++;
421: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
422: 		return;
423: 	}
424: 
425: 	chnl_cb->status_cts = uart_rsp->uart_rts;
426: 
427: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
428: 	{
429: 		tx_fail = 0x01;
430: 	}
431: 	else if ((uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data1 & ~0x3u) ||
432: 		 uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data2 || uart_rsp->mb_ack.ack_data3)
433: 	{
434: 		tx_fail = 1;
435: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_PROTOCOL_ERR;
436: 	}
437: 	else
438: 	{
439: 		tx_fail = uart_rsp->uart_tx_fail;
440: 	}
441: 
442: 	if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
443: 	{
444: 		chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx + chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
445: 					 sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
446: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
447: 		chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
448: 	}
449: 	else if (!tx_fail && chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_STATE)
450: 	{
451: 		chnl_cb->tx_fence_req = 0;
452: 		if (!chnl_cb->link_ready)
453: 		{
454: 			chnl_cb->link_ready = 1;
455: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_READY;
456: 			chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
457: 			mb_chnl_recovered(GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id));
458: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_READY);
459: 		}
460: 	}
461: 
462: 	if (tx_fail)
463: 	{
464: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_cmd == MB_UART_SEND_DATA)
465: 		{
466: 			if (chnl_cb->tx_retry)
467: 			{
468: 				chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
469: 						      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
470: 						     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
471: 				chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
472: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
473: 			}
474: 			else
475: 			{
476: 				chnl_cb->tx_retry = 1;
477: 			}
478: 		}
479: 		chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
480: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
481: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;
482: 		if (chnl_cb->probe_count < MB_UART_PROBE_MAX)
483: 		{
484: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
485: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() + MB_UART_PROBE_RETRY_MS;
486: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
487: 		}
488: 		else
489: 		{
490: 			chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
491: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
492: 			chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time() +
493: 				MB_UART_DOWN_RETRY_MS;
494: 		}
495: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
496: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
497: 			chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
498: 		return;
499: 	}
500: 
501: 	/* try next Tx. */
502: 
503: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
504: 
505: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_state_req)
506: 	{
507: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_state(chnl_cb);
508: 		if (ret_val == BK_OK)
509: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
510: 	}
511: 	if (ret_val != BK_OK)
512: 		ret_val = mb_uart_send_data(chnl_cb);
513: 
514: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
515: 	{
516: 		chnl_cb->tx_in_process = 0;  /* clear here, because no tx_cmpl_isr callback! */
517: 	}
518: 
519: 	if(chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback != NULL)
520: 	{
521: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
522: 	}
523: 
524: 	return;
525: }

527: static void mb_uart_channel_event(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_event_t event)
528: {
529: 	if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT)
530: 	{
531: 		u8 peer = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
532: 
533: 		if (!chnl_cb->tx_fence_req &&
534: 			bk_mailbox_ack_slots_used((mailbox_endpoint_t)peer) >=
535: 			MB_UART_ACK_FENCE_WATERMARK)
536: 		{
537: 			chnl_cb->tx_fence_req = 1;
538: 			chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
539: 		}
540: 	}
541: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT)
542: 	{
543: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
544: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
545: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
546: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
547: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
548: 	}
549: 	else if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED)
550: 	{
551: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
552: 		chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_DOWN;
553: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 0;
554: 		mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_DOWN);
555: 	}
556: 	else
557: 	{
558: 		if (chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len)
559: 		{
560: 			/* Delivery is unknowable after a lost ACK. Drop this chunk instead
561: 			 * of replaying terminal input and making duplicate commands. */
562: 			chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx = (chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx +
563: 					      chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len) %
564: 					     sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
565: 			chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = 0;
566: 			chnl_cb->tx_retry = 0;
567: 			chnl_cb->status_error |= MB_UART_STATUS_TX_FAIL;
568: 		}
569: 		chnl_cb->link_ready = 0;
570: 		chnl_cb->probe_count = 0;
571: 		chnl_cb->probe_due_ms = rtos_get_time();
572: 		chnl_cb->link_state = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT ?
573: 			MB_UART_LINK_ABORTING : MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
574: 		chnl_cb->tx_state_req = event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET;
575: 		if (event == MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET)
576: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
577: 		else
578: 			mb_uart_notify(chnl_cb, MB_UART_EVENT_TIMEOUT);
579: 	}
580: 
581: 	if (chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback)
582: 		chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback(chnl_cb->tx_isr_param);
583: }

585: static bk_err_t mb_uart_init(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
586: {
587: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
588: 
589: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
590: 		return BK_OK;
591: 
592: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(mb_uart_cb_t));
593: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
594: 	chnl_cb->link_state = MB_UART_LINK_PROBING;
595: 	chnl_cb->tx_state_req = 1;
596: 
597: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
598: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
599: 
600: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) ||
601: 		(chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
602: 	{
603: 		return BK_FAIL;
604: 	}
605: 
606: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
607: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
608: 	{
609: 		return ret_code;
610: 	}
611: 
612: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_rx_isr);
613: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_tx_cmpl_isr);
614: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR, NULL);
615: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR, (void *)mb_uart_channel_event);
616: 
617: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
618: 
619: 	return BK_OK;
620: }

622: static bk_err_t mb_uart_deinit(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id)
623: {
624: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
625: 		return BK_OK;
626: 
627: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, NULL);
628: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, NULL);
629: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR, NULL);
630: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_EVENT_ISR, NULL);
631: 
632: 	mb_chnl_close(chnl_id);
633: 
634: 	chnl_cb->rx_isr_callback = NULL;
635: 	chnl_cb->tx_isr_callback = NULL;
636: 
637: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 0;

642: static bk_err_t mb_uart_send_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb)
643: {
644: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
645: 
646: 	u16    rem_len, cpy_len;
647: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx;
648: 
649: 	if(chnl_cb->status_cts != 0)
650: 	{
651: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
652: 	}
653: 
654: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
655: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;
656: 
657: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
658: 	{
659: 		cpy_len = wr_idx - rd_idx;
660: 	}
661: 	else
662: 	{
663: 		cpy_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
664: 	}
665: 
666: 	if(cpy_len == 0)
667: 	{
668: 		return BK_FAIL;
669: 	}
670: 
671: 	if(cpy_len > MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN)
672: 	{
673: 		cpy_len = MB_UART_TX_FIFO_LEN;
674: 	}
675: 
676: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
677: 	{
678: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
679: 	}
680: 	else
681: 	{
682: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - rd_idx;
683: 
684: 		if(rem_len >= cpy_len)
685: 		{
686: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, cpy_len);
687: 		}
688: 		else
689: 		{
690: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, chnl_cb->tx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
691: 
692: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff + rem_len, chnl_cb->tx_buf, cpy_len - rem_len);
693: 		}
694: 	}
695: 
696: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
697: 
698: 	mb_uart_cmd_t	uart_cmd;
699: 
700: 	memset(&uart_cmd, 0, sizeof(uart_cmd));
701: 	uart_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = MB_UART_SEND_DATA;
702: 	uart_cmd.cmd_buff      = (void *)(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff);
703: 	uart_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cpy_len;
704: 	uart_cmd.uart_rts      = chnl_cb->ctrl_rts;
705: 	uart_cmd.resvd         = 0;
706: 	uart_cmd.crc8          = cal_crc8_0x31(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff, cpy_len);
707: 
708: 	ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&uart_cmd);
709: 
710: 	if(ret_val == BK_OK)
711: 	{
712: 		chnl_cb->tx_inflight_len = cpy_len;
713: 	}
714: 
715: 	return ret_val;
716: }

792: static u16 mb_uart_write_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 data_len)
793: {

797: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->tx_rd_idx;
798: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx;

800: 	if(rd_idx > wr_idx)
801: 	{
802: 		rem_len = rd_idx - wr_idx - 1;  // always reserved one byte space.
803: 	}
804: 	else
805: 	{
806: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - (wr_idx - rd_idx) - 1;
807: 	}
808: 
809: 	wr_len = data_len;
810: 	if(wr_len > rem_len)
811: 		wr_len = rem_len;
812: 
813: 	if(wr_idx < rd_idx)
814: 	{
815: 		memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
816: 	}
817: 	else
818: 	{
819: 		if(rd_idx != 0)
820: 			rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf) - wr_idx;  // if rx_idx == 0, reserved one byte at tail of the array.
821: 
822: 		if(rem_len >= wr_len)
823: 		{
824: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, wr_len);
825: 		}
826: 		else
827: 		{
828: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf + wr_idx, data_buf, rem_len);
829: 
830: 			memcpy(chnl_cb->tx_buf, data_buf + rem_len, wr_len - rem_len);
831: 		}
832: 	}
833: 
834: 	chnl_cb->tx_wr_idx = (wr_idx + wr_len) % sizeof(chnl_cb->tx_buf);
835: 
836: 	/* trigger send! */
837: 	mb_uart_send_data_trigger(chnl_cb);
838:

842: static u16 mb_uart_read_data(mb_uart_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 * data_buf, u16 buf_len)
843: {
844: 	u16    rem_len, rd_len;

846: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
847: 		return 0;
848: 
849: 	u16    rd_idx, wr_idx, data_cnt;
850: 
851: 	rd_idx = chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx;
852: 	wr_idx = chnl_cb->rx_wr_idx;
853: 
854: 	if(rd_idx <= wr_idx)
855: 	{
856: 		data_cnt = wr_idx - rd_idx;
857: 	}
858: 	else
859: 	{
860: 		data_cnt = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - (rd_idx - wr_idx);
861: 	}
862: 
863: 	rd_len = data_cnt;
864: 	if(rd_len > buf_len)
865: 		rd_len = buf_len;
866: 
867: 	if(rd_len == 0)
868: 	{
869: 		return 0;
870: 	}
871: 
872: 	if(rd_idx < wr_idx)
873: 	{
874: 		memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
875: 		chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
876: 	}
877: 	else
878: 	{
879: 		rem_len = sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - rd_idx;
880: 
881: 		if(rem_len > rd_len)
882: 		{
883: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rd_len);
884: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx += rd_len;
885: 		}
886: 		else
887: 		{
888: 			memcpy(data_buf, chnl_cb->rx_buf + rd_idx, rem_len);
889: 			if(rem_len < rd_len)
890: 			{
891: 				memcpy(data_buf + rem_len, chnl_cb->rx_buf, rd_len - rem_len);
892: 			}
893: 
894: 			chnl_cb->rx_rd_idx = rd_len - rem_len;
895: 		}
896: 	}
897: 
898: 	data_cnt -= rd_len;
899: 
900: 	/* rts assert...... */
901: 	if(data_cnt < ((sizeof(chnl_cb->rx_buf) - 1 - MB_UART_RX_FIFO_LEN) * 8 / 10))
902: 	{
903: 		if( chnl_cb->ctrl_rts != 0)
904: 		{
905: 			chnl_cb->ctrl_rts = 0;
906: 			mb_uart_send_state_trigger(chnl_cb);
907: 		}
908: 	}
909: 
910: 	return rd_len;

225: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
226: {
227: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
228: 
229: 	while (1)
230: 	{
231: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
232: 		bk_err_t ret;
233: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
234: 
235: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
236: 		{
237: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
238: 			return;
239: 		}
240: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
241: 		ack_sending = 1;
242: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
243: 
244: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
245: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
246: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
247: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
248: 		{
249: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
250: 			ack_sending = 0;
251: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
252: 			return;
253: 		}
254: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
255: 		ack_count--;
256: 		ack_sending = 0;
257: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
258: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
259: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
260: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],
261: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);

496: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
497: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
498: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
499: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
500: 	{
501: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
502: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
503: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
504: 		return;
505: 	}
506: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
507: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
508: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
509: 
510: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
511: 
512: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
513: 	{
514: 		/* clear following header members. */
515: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
516: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
517: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
518: 
519: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
520: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
521: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
522: 	} else {
523: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
524: 	}
525: 
526: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
527: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
528: 	{
529: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
530: 		return;
531: 	}
532: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
533: 	{
534: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
535: 			break;
536: 	}
537: 
538: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
539: 	{
540: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
541: 		return;
542: 	}
543: 
544: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
545: 
546: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
547: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
548: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
549: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
550: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
551: 
552: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
553: 
554: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
555: 	{
556: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
557: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
558: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
559: 	}
560: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
561: 
562: 	return;
563: 
564: }

566: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
567: {
568: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
569: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
570: 
571: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
572: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
573: 
574: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
575: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
576: 
577: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
578: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
579: 
580: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
581: 
582: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
583: 		return;
584: 
585: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
586: 		return;
587: 
588: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
589: 		return;
590: 
591: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
592: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
593: 
594: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
595: 
596: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
597: 	{
598: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
599: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
600: 
601: 		return;
602: 	}
603: 
604: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
605: 	{
606: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
607: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
608: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
609: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
610: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
611: 
612: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
613: 
614: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
615: 	}
616: 	else
617: 	{
618: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
619: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
620: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
621: 	}
622: 
623: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
624: 	{
625: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
626: 		return;
627: 	}
628: 
629: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
630: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
631: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
632: 
633: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))
634: 	{
635: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
636: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
637: 		return;
638: 	}
639: 	return;
640: }
641: 
642: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
643: {
644: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
645: 
646: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
647: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
648: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
649: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
650: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
651: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
652: 
653: 	/*
654: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
655: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
656: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
657: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
658: 	 */
659: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
660: 	{
661: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
662: 	}
663: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
664: 	{
665: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
666: 	}
667: }

669: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
670: {
671: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
672: 
673: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
674: 
675: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
676: 
677: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
678: 
679: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
680: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
681: 
682: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
683: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
684: 
685: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
686: 
687: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
688: 	{
689: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
690: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
691: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
692: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
693: 
694: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
695: 
696: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
697: 		{
698: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
699: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
700: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
701: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
702: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
703: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
704: 
705: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
706: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
707: 			}
708: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
709: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
710: 			return ret_code;
711: 		}
712: 	}
713: 
714: 	return BK_OK;
715: }

719: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
720: {
721: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
722: 	u16 			chnl_type;
723: 
724: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
725: 
726: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
727: 
728: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
729: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
730: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
731: #endif
732: 
733: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
734: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
735: 
736: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
737: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
738: 
739: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
740: 
741: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
742: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
743: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
744: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
745: 
746: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
747: 
748: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
749: 	
750: 	/*
751: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
752: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
753: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
754: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
755: 	 */
756: 	while(1)
757: 	{
758: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
759: 
760: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
761: 		{
762: 			break;
763: 		}
764: 	}
765: 
766: 	return ret_code;
767: }

770: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
771: /*
772:   * init logical chnanel module.
773:   * return:
774:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
775:   *     failed  : fail code.
776:   *
777:   */
778: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
779: {
780: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
781: 	int				i, j;
782: 
783: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
784: 
785: 	/*
786: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
787: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
788: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
789: 	 * can race here:
790: 	 *
791: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
792: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
793: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
794: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
795: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
796: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
797: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
798: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
799: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
800: 	 *
801: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
802: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
803: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
804: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
805: 	 */
806: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
807: 	{
808: 		return BK_OK;
809: 	}
810: 
811: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
812: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
813: 	{
814: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
815: 		return BK_OK;
816: 	}
817: 
818: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
819: 	memset(ack_queue, 0, sizeof(ack_queue));
820: 	ack_read = 0;
821: 	ack_write = 0;
822: 	ack_count = 0;
823: 	ack_sending = 0;
824: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
825: 	{
826: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
827: 
828: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
829: 
830: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
831: 
832: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
833: 		{
834: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
835: 		}
836: 	}
837: 
838: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
839: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
840: 	{
841: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
842: 		return ret_code;
843: 	}
844: 
845: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
846: 
847: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
848: 	{
849: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
850: 
851: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
852: 	}
853: 
854: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
855: 	bk_mailbox_rx_ready_callback_register(mb_chnl_rx_ready);
856: 
857: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
858: 
859: 	return BK_OK;
860: }

350: 	mbox0_message_t message;
351: 	mbox0_stable_slot_t *slot;
352: 	uint32_t fifo_status;
353: 	u8 ctrl;
354: 	u8 kind = 0;
355: 	u8 index = 0;
356: 	int ret_code;
357: 
358: 	(void)arg;
359: 	if (src != MAILBOX_CPU0 || dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
360: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
361: 	if (!data)
362: 		return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
363: 
364: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_get_send_stat(dst, &fifo_status);
365: 	if (ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
366: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
367: 	if (fifo_status & RX_FIFO_STAT_FULL)
368: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT;
369: 
370: 	ctrl = (data->param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
371: 	mbox0_reap_slots(dst);
372: 	slot = mbox0_alloc_slot(dst, ctrl, &kind, &index);
373: 	if (!slot)
374: 	{
375: 		adapter_diag.tx_slot_busy++;
376: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
377: 	}
378: 
379: 	memset(slot, 0, sizeof(*slot));
380: 	memcpy(&slot->data, data, sizeof(slot->data));
381: 	mailbox_slots[dst].fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
382: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
383: 	SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((u32 *)slot, sizeof(*slot));
384: #endif
385: 	__DMB();
386: 	message.data[0] = (u32)&slot->data;
387: 	message.data[1] = sizeof(slot->data);
388: 	message.dest_cpu = dst;
389: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_send_message(&message);
390: 	if (ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
391: 	{
392: 		mbox0_release_slot(dst, kind, index);
393: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_NOT_INIT;
394: 	}
395: 	return BK_OK;
396: }
397: 
398: void bk_mailbox_tx_complete(mailbox_endpoint_t dst)
399: {
400: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
401: 	u32 completed_order;
402: 	u8 i;
403: 
404: 	if (dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
405: 		return;
406: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
407: 	if (!slots->cmd_active)
408: 		return;
409: 	completed_order = slots->cmd_order[slots->cmd_active - 1];
410: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
411: 	{
412: 		if (slots->ack_used[i] && slots->ack_order[i] < completed_order)
413: 			slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
414: 	}
415: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
416: 	{
417: 		if (slots->cmd_used[i] && slots->cmd_order[i] <= completed_order)
418: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
419: 	}
420: 	if (slots->reset_used && slots->reset_order < completed_order)
421: 		slots->reset_used = 0;
422: 	if (slots->sync_used && slots->sync_order < completed_order)
423: 		slots->sync_used = 0;
424: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
425: }

203: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_rd = (s_ap_bridge.tx_rd + written) %
204: 					 sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
205: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_bytes += written;
206: 		rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
207: 	}

210: static void ap_bridge_task(beken_thread_arg_t arg)
211: {
212: 	u8 input[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];
213: 	u8 line[AP_BRIDGE_LOG_LINE_SIZE];
214: 	u16 line_length = 0;
215: 	u8 active_mode = AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_LOG;
216: 	bool line_continues = false;
217: 
218: 	(void)arg;
219: 	for (;;)
220: 	{
221: 		u32 events;
222: 		u32 flags;
223: 		u16 input_length;
224: 		u16 index;
225: 		u8 ready_set;
226: 		u8 ready_clear;
227: 		u8 ready_before;
228: 		bk_err_t ret = rtos_get_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem,
229: 			line_length ? AP_BRIDGE_LOG_FLUSH_MS : 20);
230: 
231: 		bk_mb_uart_poll(MB_UART0);
232: 
233: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
234: 		events = s_ap_bridge.events;
235: 		s_ap_bridge.events = 0;
236: 		ready_set = s_ap_bridge.ready_set;
237: 		ready_clear = s_ap_bridge.ready_clear;
238: 		ready_before = s_ap_bridge.ready_flags;
239: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_set = 0;
240: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_clear = 0;
241: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);
242: 
243: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
244: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
245: 		{
246: 			ready_clear |= AP_BRIDGE_READY_MBUART;
247: 		}
248: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_flags |= ready_set;
249: 		s_ap_bridge.ready_flags &= ~ready_clear;
250: 		s_ap_bridge.link_ready =
251: 			(s_ap_bridge.ready_flags & AP_BRIDGE_READY_ALL) ==
252: 			AP_BRIDGE_READY_ALL && bk_mb_uart_is_link_ready(MB_UART0);
253: 
254: 		if (s_ap_bridge.mode_applied_generation !=
255: 			s_ap_bridge.mode_generation)
256: 		{
257: 			if (line_length)
258: 				ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length, !line_continues);
259: 			line_length = 0;
260: 			line_continues = false;
261: 			active_mode = s_ap_bridge.requested_mode;
262: 			s_ap_bridge.output_mode = active_mode;
263: 			s_ap_bridge.mode_applied_generation =
264: 				s_ap_bridge.mode_generation;
265: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem);
266: 		}
267: 
268: 		do
269: 		{
270: 			input_length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, input, sizeof(input));
271: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_bytes += input_length;
272: 			if (active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_RAW)
273: 			{
274: 				if (input_length && !shell_log_raw_data(input, input_length))
275: 					s_ap_bridge.stats.rx_queue_fail++;
276: 				continue;
277: 			}
278: 
279: 			for (index = 0; index < input_length; index++)
280: 			{
281: 				line[line_length++] = input[index];
282: 				if (input[index] == '\n' || line_length == sizeof(line))
283: 				{
284: 					bool complete = input[index] == '\n';
285: 
286: 					ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length,
287: 							     !line_continues);
288: 					line_length = 0;
289: 					line_continues = !complete;
290: 				}
291: 			}
292: 		} while (input_length != 0);
293: 
294: 		if (ret == kTimeoutErr && line_length &&
295: 			active_mode == AP_CONSOLE_OUTPUT_LOG)
296: 		{
297: 			ap_bridge_log_output(line, line_length, !line_continues);
298: 			line_length = 0;
299: 			line_continues = true;
300: 		}
301: 
302: 		ap_bridge_drain_tx();
303: 
304: 		if (events & (AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_DOWN | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET |
305: 			      AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT))
306: 		{
307: 			u32 now = rtos_get_time();
308: 
309: 			s_ap_bridge.stats.link_down++;
310: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RESET)
311: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.reset++;
312: 			if (events & AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TIMEOUT)
313: 				s_ap_bridge.stats.timeout++;
314: 			if ((ready_before & (AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC |
315: 					     AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC)) ==
316: 				(AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC | AP_BRIDGE_READY_PWC) &&
317: 				(u32)(now - s_ap_bridge.last_down_log_ms) >= 1000)
318: 			{
319: 				s_ap_bridge.last_down_log_ms = now;
320: 				BK_LOGW(AP_BRIDGE_TAG,
321: 					"link down event=%x queued=%u ready=%x\r\n",
322: 					events, ap_bridge_tx_count(),
323: 					s_ap_bridge.ready_flags);
324: 			}
325: 			shell_ap_console_link_down();
326: 		}
327: 	}
328: }

330: bk_err_t ap_console_bridge_init(void)
331: {
332: 	bk_err_t ret;
333: 
334: 	memset(&s_ap_bridge, 0, sizeof(s_ap_bridge));
335: 	ret = bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_MAILBOX, 0, 0);
336: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
337: 		return ret;
338: 	ret = rtos_init_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
339: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
340: 		goto init_fail_vote;
341: 	ret = rtos_init_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem, 1);
342: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
343: 		goto init_fail_mutex;
344: 	ret = rtos_init_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem, 1);
345: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
346: 		goto init_fail_sem;
347: 
348: 	ret = rtos_create_thread(&s_ap_bridge.thread,
349: 					 BEKEN_DEFAULT_WORKER_PRIORITY,
350: 					 "ap_console", ap_bridge_task, 3072, NULL);
351: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
352: 	{
353: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem);
354: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem);
355: 		goto init_fail_mutex;
356: 	}
357: 
358: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0);
359: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
360: 	{
361: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_bridge.thread);
362: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem);
363: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem);
364: 		goto init_fail_mutex;
365: 	}
366: 
367: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_register_rx_isr(MB_UART0, ap_bridge_mb_rx, NULL);
368: 	if (ret == BK_OK)
369: 		ret = bk_mb_uart_register_tx_isr(MB_UART0, ap_bridge_mb_tx, NULL);
370: 	if (ret == BK_OK)
371: 		ret = bk_mb_uart_register_event_callback(MB_UART0, ap_bridge_mb_event, NULL);
372: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
373: 	{
374: 		bk_mb_uart_dev_deinit(MB_UART0);
375: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_bridge.thread);
376: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.mode_sem);
377: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem);
378: 		goto init_fail_mutex;
379: 	}
380: 
381: 	ap_bridge_wake(AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_RX | AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TX);
382: 	BK_LOGI(AP_BRIDGE_TAG, "init owner=MB_UART0 tx_ring=%u mode=LOG\r\n",
383: 		(unsigned)sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring));
384: 	return BK_OK;
385: 
386: init_fail_sem:
387: 	rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_bridge.sem);
388: init_fail_mutex:
389: 	rtos_deinit_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
390: init_fail_vote:
391: 	bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_MAILBOX, 1, 0);
392: 	return ret;
393: }

395: u16 ap_console_bridge_write(const u8 *data, u16 length)
396: {
397: 	u16 written = 0;
398: 
399: 	if (!data || !length || !s_ap_bridge.link_ready)
400: 		return 0;
401: 
402: 	rtos_lock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
403: 	while (written < length)
404: 	{
405: 		u16 next = (s_ap_bridge.tx_wr + 1) % sizeof(s_ap_bridge.tx_ring);
406: 		if (next == s_ap_bridge.tx_rd)
407: 			break;
408: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_ring[s_ap_bridge.tx_wr] = data[written++];
409: 		s_ap_bridge.tx_wr = next;
410: 	}
411: 	rtos_unlock_mutex(&s_ap_bridge.tx_mutex);
412: 	if (written < length)
413: 	{
414: 		s_ap_bridge.stats.tx_drop += length - written;
415: 	}
416: 	if (written)
417: 		ap_bridge_wake(AP_BRIDGE_EVENT_TX);
418: 	return written;
419: }

425: 	s_ap_bridge.tx_rd = s_ap_bridge.tx_wr;

98:                            uint16_t size)

100:   return write_index >= read_index ? write_index - read_index :
101:          size - read_index + write_index;

124: static void update_local_rts(void)
125: {
126:   bool new_rts = g_uart.upper_rts || rx_free() <= MB_UART_RTS_ASSERT;

129:     {

131:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
132:       if (new_rts)
133:         {

135:         }
136:       else

143: static bool valid_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack)
144: {
145:   return ack != NULL && (ack->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
146:          ack->payload_length == 0 && ack->flags == 0 && ack->crc8 == 0 &&
147:          ack->reserved == 0;
148: }

150: static void mb_uart_tx_complete(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
151:                                 int result, void *arg)
152: {
153:   irqstate_t flags;
154:   uint8_t command;
155:   bool failed;
156: 
157:   (void)arg;
158:   flags = up_irq_save();
159:   command = ack == NULL ? g_uart.transaction_command :
160:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(ack);
161:   failed = result < 0 || !valid_ack(ack) ||
162:            (ack != NULL && (ack->payload_address & 2u) != 0);
163: 
164:   if (ack != NULL && valid_ack(ack))
165:     {
166:       g_uart.peer_rts = (ack->payload_address & 1u) != 0;
167:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
168:     }
169: 
170:   if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)
171:     {
172:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = false;
173:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
174:     }
175: 
176:   if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && g_uart.tx_inflight != 0)
177:     {
178:       if (!failed)
179:         {
180:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
181:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
182:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
183:         }
184:       else if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)
185:         {
186:           /* A failed/unknown ACK cannot tell whether CP consumed the bytes.
187:            * Drop this local chunk rather than replaying terminal characters.
188:            */
189: 
190:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
191:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
192:           g_uart.stats.tx_unknown++;
193:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
194:           g_uart.stats.resets++;
195:         }
196:       else
197:         {
198:           g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
199:           g_uart.state_pending = true;
200:           if (g_uart.tx_retry_count == 0)
201:             {
202:               /* Keep tx_read unchanged.  The same chunk may be copied again
203:                * once STATE recovery succeeds, but only once.
204:                */
205: 
206:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 1;
207:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry++;
208:             }
209:           else
210:             {
211:               g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
212:                                MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
213:               g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
214:               g_uart.stats.tx_retry_drop++;
215:             }
216:         }
217: 
218:       g_uart.tx_inflight = 0;
219:     }
220:   else if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE && failed)
221:     {
222:       g_uart.stats.remote_fail++;
223:       /* The transport invokes this completion before it changes READY to
224:        * ABORTING.  Always retain a STATE request so RESET recovery has a
225:        * probe to send after it reaches PROBING.
226:        */
227: 
228:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
229:     }
230: 
231:   g_uart.transaction_busy = false;
232:   up_irq_restore(flags);
233:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
234: }

236: static int mb_uart_receive(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
237:                            uint8_t *ack_flags, void *arg)
238: {
239:   uint8_t command = bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message);
240:   uint16_t length = message->payload_length;
241:   uint16_t first;
242:   bool failed = false;
243:   bool malformed = false;
244: 
245:   (void)arg;
246:   if (ack_flags == NULL)
247:     {
248:       return -EINVAL;
249:     }
250: 
251:   if (command != BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && command != BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
252:     {
253:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
254:       failed = true;
255:       malformed = true;
256:     }
257:   else if ((message->flags & ~1u) != 0)
258:     {
259:       g_uart.stats.bad_flags++;
260:       failed = true;
261:       malformed = true;
262:     }
263:   else if (message->crc8 != 0)
264:     {
265:       g_uart.stats.bad_crc++;
266:       g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_PARITY;
267:       failed = true;
268:       malformed = true;
269:     }
270:   else if (message->reserved != 0)
271:     {
272:       g_uart.stats.bad_reserved++;
273:       failed = true;
274:       malformed = true;
275:     }
276: 
277:   if (!failed && command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA)
278:     {
279:       if (message->payload_address != BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS)
280:         {
281:           g_uart.stats.bad_pointer++;
282:           failed = true;
283:           malformed = true;
284:         }
285:       else if (length == 0 || length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
286:         {
287:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
288:           failed = true;
289:           malformed = true;
290:         }
291:       else if (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
292:         {
293:           failed = true;
294:         }
295:       else if (rx_free() < length)
296:         {
297:           g_uart.stats.rx_overflow++;
298:           g_uart.sticky_status |= MB_UART_STATUS_OVF;
299:           failed = true;
300:         }
301:       else
302:         {
303:           const uint8_t *source =
304:             (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS;
305: 
306:           __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
307:           first = MB_UART_RX_SIZE - g_uart.rx_write;
308:           if (first > length)
309:             {
310:               first = length;
311:             }
312: 
313:           memcpy(&g_uart.rx_ring[g_uart.rx_write], source, first);
314:           if (first != length)
315:             {
316:               memcpy(g_uart.rx_ring, source + first, length - first);
317:             }
318: 
319:           g_uart.rx_write = (g_uart.rx_write + length) % MB_UART_RX_SIZE;
320:           g_uart.stats.data_rx++;
321:           g_uart.stats.rx_bytes += length;
322:         }
323:     }
324:   else if (!failed)
325:     {
326:       if (message->payload_address != 0 || message->payload_length != 0)
327:         {
328:           g_uart.stats.bad_length++;
329:           failed = true;
330:           malformed = true;
331:         }
332:       else
333:         {
334:           g_uart.stats.state_rx++;
335:         }
336:     }
337: 
338:   if (!malformed)
339:     {
340:       bool old_peer_rts = g_uart.peer_rts;
341: 
342:       g_uart.peer_rts = (message->flags & 1u) != 0;
343:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
344:       if (old_peer_rts && !g_uart.peer_rts)
345:         {
346:           nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
347:         }
348:     }
349: 
350:   update_local_rts();
351:   *ack_flags = (g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u) | (failed ? 2u : 0u);
352:   nxsem_post(&g_uart.worker_sem);
353:   return malformed ? -EPROTO : OK;
354: }

356: static int send_state_locked(void)
357: {
358:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
359:   int ret;
360: 
361:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
362:   message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(BK7258_MB_UART_STATE, 0, 0, 0,
363:                                          BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX);
364:   message.flags = g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u;
365:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX, &message,
366:                                   mb_uart_tx_complete, NULL);
367:   if (ret == OK)
368:     {
369:       g_uart.transaction_busy = true;
370:       g_uart.transaction_command = BK7258_MB_UART_STATE;
371:       g_uart.state_pending = false;
372:       g_uart.stats.state_tx++;
373:     }
374: 
375:   return ret;
376: }

378: static int send_data_locked(void)
379: {
380:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
381:   uint8_t *destination =
382:     (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS;
383:   uint16_t length = tx_count();
384:   uint16_t first;
385:   int ret;
386: 
387:   if (length > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE)
388:     {
389:       length = BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE;
390:     }
391: 
392:   if (length == 0 || g_uart.peer_rts)
393:     {
394:       return -EAGAIN;
395:     }
396: 
397:   first = MB_UART_TX_SIZE - g_uart.tx_read;
398:   if (first > length)
399:     {
400:       first = length;
401:     }
402: 
403:   memcpy(destination, &g_uart.tx_ring[g_uart.tx_read], first);
404:   if (first != length)
405:     {
406:       memcpy(destination + first, g_uart.tx_ring, length - first);
407:     }
408: 
409:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
410:   message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(BK7258_MB_UART_DATA, 0, 0, 0,
411:                                          BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX);
412:   message.payload_address = BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS;
413:   message.payload_length = length;
414:   message.flags = g_uart.local_rts ? 1u : 0u;
415:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
416:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX, &message,
417:                                   mb_uart_tx_complete, NULL);
418:   if (ret == OK)
419:     {
420:       g_uart.transaction_busy = true;
421:       g_uart.transaction_command = BK7258_MB_UART_DATA;
422:       g_uart.tx_inflight = length;
423:       g_uart.stats.data_tx++;
424:     }
425: 
426:   return ret;
427: }

429: static int mb_uart_worker(int argc, char **argv)
430: {
431:   (void)argc;
432:   (void)argv;
433: 
434:   for (;;)
435:     {
436:       bk7258_mb_uart_callback_t callback;
437:       void *callback_arg;
438:       irqstate_t flags;
439: 
440:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_uart.worker_sem,
441:                                            MB_UART_WORK_INTERVAL);
442:       flags = up_irq_save();
443: 
444:       if (!g_uart.transaction_busy)
445:         {
446:           enum bk7258_mb_link_state link = bk7258_mailbox_link_state();
447: 
448:           if (link == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING && g_uart.state_pending)
449:             {
450:               (void)send_state_locked();
451:             }
452:           else if (link == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
453:             {
454:               if (g_uart.state_pending)
455:                 {
456:                   (void)send_state_locked();
457:                 }
458:               else
459:                 {
460:                   (void)send_data_locked();
