23: #if defined(CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM) && \
24:     CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_SIZE != BK7258_PSRAM_SIZE
25: #  error "BK7258 OpenVela and app_ab PSRAM capacities differ"
26: #endif
27: 
28: int bk7258_syslog_initialize(void);
29: 
30: extern const uint8_t _eronly[];
31: extern uint8_t _sdata[];
32: extern uint8_t _edata[];
33: extern uint8_t _sbss[];
34: extern uint8_t _ebss[];
35: extern uint8_t __ram_vectors_load[];
36: extern uint8_t __ram_vectors_start[];
37: extern uint8_t __ram_vectors_end[];
38: extern uint8_t __idle_stack_base[];
39: extern uint8_t __idle_stack_top[];
40: 
41: const uintptr_t g_idle_topstack = (uintptr_t)__idle_stack_top;
42: 
43: static const struct mpu_region_s g_bk7258_mpu_regions[] =
44: {
45:   {
46:     BK7258_AP_FLASH_BASE,
47:     BK7258_AP_FLASH_SIZE,
48:     MPU_RBAR_AP_RORO | MPU_RBAR_SH_NO,
49:     MPU_RLAR_WRITE_THROUGH
50:   },
51:   {
52:     BK7258_AP_RAM_BASE,
53:     BK7258_AP_RAM_SIZE,
54:     MPU_RBAR_XN | MPU_RBAR_AP_RWRW | MPU_RBAR_SH_INNER,
55:     MPU_RLAR_NONCACHEABLE
56:   },
57:   {
58:     BK7258_CP_RAM_START,
59:     BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_CP_RAM_START,
60:     MPU_RBAR_XN | MPU_RBAR_AP_RORO | MPU_RBAR_SH_INNER,
61:     MPU_RLAR_NONCACHEABLE
62:   },
63:   {
64:     BK7258_MB_UART_RX_ADDRESS,
65:     BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE,
66:     MPU_RBAR_XN | MPU_RBAR_AP_RORO | MPU_RBAR_SH_INNER,
67:     MPU_RLAR_NONCACHEABLE
68:   },
69:   {
70:     BK7258_MB_UART_TX_ADDRESS,
71:     BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE,
72:     MPU_RBAR_XN | MPU_RBAR_AP_RWRW | MPU_RBAR_SH_INNER,
73:     MPU_RLAR_NONCACHEABLE
74:   },
75: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
76:   {
77:     BK7258_PSRAM_BASE,
78:     BK7258_PSRAM_SIZE,
79:     /* Match the BK7258 vendor AP mapping.  The PSRAM controller's normal,
80:      * non-cacheable window is non-shareable on this interconnect.
81:      */
82: 
83:     MPU_RBAR_XN | MPU_RBAR_AP_RWRW | MPU_RBAR_SH_NO,
84:     MPU_RLAR_NONCACHEABLE
85:   },
86: #endif
87:   {
88:     0x40000000u,
89:     0x20000000u,
90:     MPU_RBAR_XN | MPU_RBAR_AP_RWRW | MPU_RBAR_SH_INNER,
91:     MPU_RLAR_DEVICE
92:   },
93: };

95: static void __attribute__((used, noinline, noreturn,
96:                            target("general-regs-only")))
97: bk7258_start(void)
98: {
99:   const uint8_t *src;
100:   uint8_t *dest;
101: 
102:   /* Enable CP10/CP11 before code compiled for the hard-float ABI can use the
103:    * floating-point extension.
104:    */
105: 
106:   modifyreg32(NVIC_CPACR, 0,
107:               NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(10) | NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(11));
108:   UP_DSB();
109:   UP_ISB();
110: 
111:   /* Match the current golden SPE SAU setup: the secure alias is retained,
112:    * while the 0x10000000 non-secure alias range is exposed as non-secure.
113:    */
114: 
115:   putreg32(0, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
116:   putreg32(0x00000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
117:   putreg32(0x0fffffe3u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
118:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
119:   putreg32(0x10000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
120:   putreg32(0xefffffe1u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
121:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x00);
122:   UP_DSB();
123:   UP_ISB();
124: 
125:   for (src = _eronly, dest = _sdata; dest < _edata; )
126:     {
127:       *dest++ = *src++;
128:     }
129: 
130:   for (dest = _sbss; dest < _ebss; )
131:     {
132:       *dest++ = 0;
133:     }
134: 
135:   for (src = __ram_vectors_load, dest = __ram_vectors_start;
136:        dest < __ram_vectors_end; )
137:     {
138:       *dest++ = *src++;
139:     }
140: 
141:   putreg32((uintptr_t)__ram_vectors_start, NVIC_VECTAB);
142:   UP_DSB();
143:   UP_ISB();
144: 
145:   /* Install the buffered AP log channel before normal NuttX startup. */
146:   (void)bk7258_syslog_initialize();
147: 
148: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM_MPU
149:   {
150:     const size_t region_count = sizeof(g_bk7258_mpu_regions) /
151:                                 sizeof(g_bk7258_mpu_regions[0]);
152:     const uint32_t hardware_regions =
153:       (getreg32(MPU_TYPE) & MPU_TYPE_DREGION_MASK) >>
154:       MPU_TYPE_DREGION_SHIFT;
155: 
156:     if (hardware_regions < region_count)
157:       {
158:         /* A missing shared-memory region would silently widen privileged
159:          * access through PRIVDEFENA.  Refuse to boot rather than claim
160:          * permissions that the hardware did not install.
161:          */
162: 
163:         syslog(LOG_ERR, "BK7258 MPU has %lu regions, needs %zu\n",
164:                (unsigned long)hardware_regions, region_count);
165:         for (; ; )
166:           {
167:           }
168:       }
169: 
170:     syslog(LOG_INFO, "BK7258 MPU regions=%zu/%lu, shared RX RO TX RW\n",
171:            region_count, (unsigned long)hardware_regions);
172:     mpu_reset();
173:     mpu_initialize(g_bk7258_mpu_regions, region_count, false, true);
174:   }
175: #endif
176: 
177: #ifdef USE_EARLYSERIALINIT
178:   arm_earlyserialinit();
179: #endif
180: 
181:   nx_start();
182:   for (; ; )
183:     {
184:     }
185: }
186: 
187: void __attribute__((naked, noreturn, section(".start_text"))) __start(void)
188: {
189:   __asm__ volatile
190:     (
191:       "cpsid i\n"
192:       "ldr r0, =__idle_stack_base\n"
193:       "msr msplim, r0\n"
194:       "b bk7258_start\n"
195:     );
196: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 PWC worker and CPU1 ready handshake.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: #include <stdint.h>
7: #include <stdbool.h>
8: #include <stdio.h>
9: 
10: #include <nuttx/semaphore.h>
11: #include <nuttx/sched.h>
12: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
13: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
14: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
15: 
16: #include "bk7258_psram.h"
17: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
18: 
19: #define PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD 0x5u
20: #define PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD 0x7u
21: #define PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD 0x8u
22: #define PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD 0x9u
23: #define PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD 0xau
24: #define PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1 11u
25: #define PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON 0u
26: #define PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF 1u
27: #define PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT 0u
28: #define PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH 1u
29: #define PM_QUEUE_DEPTH 8u
30: #define PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS 500u
31: #define PM_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS 1000u
32: 
33: struct pwc_message
34: {
35:   uint32_t header;
36:   uint32_t param1;
37:   uint32_t param2;
38:   uint32_t param3;
39: };
40: 
41: static struct pwc_message g_queue[PM_QUEUE_DEPTH];
42: static volatile unsigned int g_head;
43: static volatile unsigned int g_tail;
44: static sem_t g_pwc_sem;
45: static sem_t g_worker_sem;
46: static sem_t g_psram_power_sem;
47: static volatile bool g_worker_ready;
48: static volatile bool g_ready_sent;
49: static volatile bool g_psram_power_waiting;
50: static volatile uint32_t g_psram_power_state;
51: 
52: static void psram_power_vote_rollback(void)
53: {
54:   int ret;
55: 
56:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD,
57:                                 PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
58:                                 PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF, 0);
59:   if (ret >= 0)
60:     {
61:       ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_pwc(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
62:     }
63: 
64:   if (ret < 0)
65:     {
66:       printf("PWC: PSRAM power vote rollback failed, error=%d\n", ret);
67:     }
68: }
69: 
70: static int ipc_heartbeat_worker(int argc, char **argv)
71: {
72:   static uint32_t heartbeat_payload;
73: 
74:   (void)argc;
75:   (void)argv;
76:   for (;;)
77:     {
78:       nxsig_usleep(2000000);
79:       (void)bk7258_mbox_send_message(2, 0x10,
80:                                      (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)&heartbeat_payload,
81:                                      sizeof(heartbeat_payload), 0);
82:     }
83:   return 0;
84: }
85: 
86: static void pwc_rx(const void *raw)
87: {
88:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
89:   struct pwc_message message;
90:   unsigned int next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
91:   if (next == g_tail || bytes == NULL)
92:     {
93:       return;
94:     }
95:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
96:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
97:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
98:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
99:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
100:   g_head = next;
101:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
102: }
103: 
104: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
105: {
106:   (void)argc;
107:   (void)argv;
108:   g_worker_ready = true;
109:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
110:   for (;;)
111:     {
112:       struct pwc_message message;
113:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
114:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
115:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
116:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
117:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
118:         {
119:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
120:             /* The unmodified AVDK SMP firmware returns the requested ON/OFF
121:              * state in param1. It does not expose the PSRAM driver result or
122:              * detected capacity, so AP validates its configured regions with
123:              * the non-destructive boundary probe before creating allocators.
124:              */
125: 
126:             g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
127:             if (g_psram_power_waiting)
128:               {
129:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
130:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
131:               }
132:             break;
133: 
134: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
135:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
136:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
137:               {
138:                 (void)bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
139:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
140:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
141:                   bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
142:               }
143:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
144:               {
145:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
146: 
147:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
148:               }
149:             break;
150: 
151:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
152:             bk7258_psram_dump();
153:             break;
154: 
155:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
156:             {
157:               int ret = bk7258_psram_shutdown();
158: 
159:               (void)bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
160:                 PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
161:                 ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
162:                            PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT, 0);
163:             }
164:             break;
165: #endif
166: 
167:           default:
168:             break;
169:         }
170:     }
171:   return 0;
172: }
173: 
174: int bk7258_pwc_start(void)
175: {
176:   int pid;
177:   int ret;
178: 
179:   nxsem_init(&g_pwc_sem, 0, 0);
180:   nxsem_init(&g_worker_sem, 0, 0);
181:   nxsem_init(&g_psram_power_sem, 0, 0);
182:   g_head = 0;
183:   g_tail = 0;
184:   g_worker_ready = false;
185:   g_ready_sent = false;
186:   g_psram_power_waiting = false;
187:   g_psram_power_state = PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF;
188:   bk7258_mailbox_set_pwc_rx(pwc_rx);
189:   /* Match Armino mb_ipc_heartbeat: notify CPU0 before PM ready and keep the
190:    * CPU1 liveness indication independent from the PWC worker. */
191:   if (bk7258_mbox_send_message(1, 0x10, 0, 0, 0) != 0)
192:     {
193:       return -1;
194:     }
195: 
196:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_hw_control(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
197:   if (ret < 0)
198:     {
199:       printf("PWC: IPC power-up transport timeout, error=%d\n", ret);
200:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
201:       return ret;
202:     }
203:   printf("PWC: IPC power-up transport complete\n");
204: 
205:   if (kthread_create("ipc-heartbeat", 100, 1536, ipc_heartbeat_worker,
206:                      NULL) < 0)
207:     {
208:       return -1;
209:     }
210:   pid = kthread_create("pwc", 110, 2048, pwc_worker, NULL);
211:   if (pid < 0)
212:     {
213:       return pid;
214:     }
215:   if (nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_worker_sem, MSEC2TICK(200)) < 0 ||
216:       !g_worker_ready)
217:     {
218:       printf("PWC: worker start timeout\n");
219:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
220:       return -ETIMEDOUT;
221:     }
222:   printf("PWC: worker ready\n");
223: 
224:   /* CP boots CPU1 from its low-power worker and waits there for this ready
225:    * command. Send it before requesting PSRAM, whose vote is handled by that
226:    * same worker, otherwise the two cores deadlock waiting for each other.
227:    */
228: 
229:   g_ready_sent = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD,
230:                                          1, 0, 0) == 0;
231:   if (!g_ready_sent)
232:     {
233:       printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready queue failed\n");
234:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
235:       return -EIO;
236:     }
237: 
238:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_pwc(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
239:   if (ret < 0)
240:     {
241:       printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready transport timeout, error=%d\n", ret);
242:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
243:       return ret;
244:     }
245: 
246:   printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready acknowledged by CP transport\n");
247: 
248: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
249:   g_psram_power_waiting = true;
250:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD,
251:                                 PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
252:                                 PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON, 0);
253:   if (ret >= 0)
254:     {
255:       ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_psram_power_sem,
256:                          MSEC2TICK(PM_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS));
257:     }
258: 
259:   g_psram_power_waiting = false;
260:   if (ret < 0 || g_psram_power_state != PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)
261:     {
262:       printf("PWC: PSRAM power response failed, error=%d state=%lu\n",
263:              ret, (unsigned long)g_psram_power_state);
264:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
265:       psram_power_vote_rollback();
266: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_REQUIRED
267:       return ret < 0 ? ret : -EIO;
268: #endif
269:     }
270:   else
271:     {
272:       /* printf("PWC: PSRAM power vote ON acknowledged\n"); */
273:       ret = bk7258_psram_initialize();
274:       if (ret < 0)
275:         {
276:           printf("PWC: PSRAM allocator initialization failed, error=%d\n",
277:                  ret);
278:           psram_power_vote_rollback();
279: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_REQUIRED
280:           return ret;
281: #endif
282:         }
283:       else
284:         {
285:           /* printf("PWC: PSRAM allocators ONLINE\n"); */
286:         }
287:     }
288: #endif
289: 
290:   if (g_ready_sent)
291:     {
292:       return 0;
293:     }
294: 
295:   return -1;
296: }

125: static void ipc_cmd_rx_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
126: {
127: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
128: 	mb_chnl_ack_t * ack_buf = (mb_chnl_ack_t *)cmd_buf;
129: 	ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (ipc_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
130: 
131: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
132: 
133: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_FLAG)  /* ipc rsp from other CPU. */
134: 	{
135: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* unsolicited ipc response. */
136: 		{
137: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
138: 		}
139: 
140: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd != (cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_MASK))
141: 		{
142: 			/* un-matched rpc response. */
143: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
144: 		}
145: 
146: 		/* communication ok, function is completed. */
147: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
148: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
149: 
150: 		BK_LOGD(MOD_TAG, "IPC_RSP_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
151: 
152: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
153: 		{
154: 			/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
155: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
156: 			chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
157: 		}
158: 		else
159: 		{
160: 			/* returns ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
161: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
162: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
163: 			{
164: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
165: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
166: 				#endif
167: 				__DMB();
168: 				
169: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
170: 
171: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
172: 			}
173: 			else
174: 			{
175: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
176: 			}
177: 		}
178: 
179: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
180: 
181: 		ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
182: 
183: 		/* it is a rsp command, nothing need to be returned. */
184: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = NULL;
185: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
186: 
187: 		result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
188: 
189: 		goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
190: 	}
191: 	else
192: 	{
193: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
194: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 1;
195: 
196: 		BK_LOGV(MOD_TAG, "IPC_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
197: 
198: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->cmd_buf))
199: 		{
200: 			result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
201: 		}
202: 		else
203: 		{
204: 			/* may return ACK_STATE_COMPLETE, 
205: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
206: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
207: 			{
208: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
209: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
210: 				#endif
211: 				__DMB();
212: 				
213: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->cmd_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
214: 
215: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
216: 			}
217: 			else
218: 			{
219: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = 0;
220: 			}
221: 
222: 			result = chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler(chnl_cb, ack_buf);
223: 		}
224: 
225: 		if(result != ACK_STATE_PENDING)
226: 			chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 0;
227: 	}
228: 
229: ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit:
230: 
231: 	/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle complete.
232: 	 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
233: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
234: 	 */
235: 	ack_buf->ack_state = result;
236: 
237: 	return;
238: 
239: }

241: static void ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
242: {
243: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.cmd == chnl_cb->tx_cmd)
244: 	{
245: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* RSP_CMD rx_isr may arrive before this tx_cmpl_isr. */
246: 			return;
247: 
248: 		/* IPC cmd tx complete. */
249: 
250: 		if( (ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) 
251: 			|| (ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_FAIL) )
252: 		{
253: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
254: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;
255: 
256: 			/* communication failed or function failed. */
257: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
258: 		}
259: 		else if(ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_COMPLETE)
260: 		{
261: 			/* communication ok, function is completed. */
262: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
263: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
264: 
265: 			ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
266: 
267: 			/* chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
268: 
269: 			if(ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
270: 			{
271: 				/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
272: 				chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
273: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
274: 			}
275: 			else
276: 			{
277: 				if((ipc_rsp->rsp_buff != NULL) && (ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > 0))
278: 				{
279: 					#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
280: 					flush_dcache(ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
281: 					#endif
282: 					__DMB();
283: 
284: 					memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
285: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len;
286: 				}
287: 				else
288: 				{
289: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
290: 				}
291: 			}
292: 			
293: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
294: 		}
295: 		else
296: 		{
297: 			/* communication ok, function is pending. */
298: 		}
299: 
300: 		return;
301: 	}
302: 
303: 	/*
304: 	 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
305: 	 */
306: 	BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault in %s,cmd:%d\r\n", __func__, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
307: 
308: 	return;
309: 
310: }

312: static bk_err_t ipc_chnl_init(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id, ipc_rx_cmd_hdlr_t rx_handler)
313: {
314: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
315: 
316: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
317: 		return BK_OK;
318: 
319: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(ipc_chnl_cb_t));
320: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
321: 
322: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
323: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
324: 
325: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) || 
326: 		(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
327: 	{
328: 		return BK_FAIL;
329: 	}
330: 
331: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore_adv(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, 1, 1);
332: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
333: 	{
334: 		return ret_code;
335: 	}
336: 
337: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, 1);
338: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
339: 	{
340: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
341: 
342: 		return ret_code;
343: 	}
344: 
345: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
346: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
347: 	{
348: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
349: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
350: 
351: 		return ret_code;
352: 	}
353: 
354: 	chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler = rx_handler;
355: 
356: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_rx_isr);
357: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr);
358: 
359: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
360: 
361: 	return BK_OK;
362: }

364: static bk_err_t ipc_send_cmd(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 cmd, u8 *cmd_buf, u16 cmd_len, u8 * rsp_buf, u16 rsp_buf_len)
365: {
366: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
367: 	ipc_cmd_t	ipc_cmd;
368: 
369: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited){
370: 		ipc_init();
371: 	}
372: 
373: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
374: 		return BK_FAIL;
375: 
376: 	rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
377: 
378: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = cmd;
379: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
380: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 1;
381: 
382: 	void * dst_buf = (void *)chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff;
383: 
384: 	do
385: 	{
386: 		if(cmd_len > IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
387: 		{
388: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
389: 			break;
390: 		}
391: 
392: 		if(cmd_buf == NULL)
393: 			cmd_len = 0;
394: 
395: 		if(cmd_len > 0)
396: 			memcpy(dst_buf, cmd_buf, cmd_len);
397: 
398: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.data = 0;	/* clear hdr. */
399: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = cmd;
400: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_buff      = dst_buf;
401: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cmd_len;
402: 
403: 		ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&ipc_cmd);
404: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
405: 		{
406: 			break;
407: 		}
408: 
409: 		ret_val = rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, IPC_RSP_TIMEOUT);  /* isr_callback will set this semaphore. */
410: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
411: 		{
412: 			break;
413: 		}
414: 
415: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;  /* must have been set to 0 by callback. */
416: 
417: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed)
418: 		{
419: 			ret_val = BK_FAIL;
420: 			break;
421: 		}
422: 
423: 		if((rsp_buf == NULL) || (rsp_buf_len == 0))
424: 		{
425: 			ret_val = BK_OK;
426: 			break;
427: 		}
428: 
429: 		if(rsp_buf_len < chnl_cb->rsp_len)
430: 		{
431: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
432: 			break;
433: 		}
434: 
435: 		if(chnl_cb->rsp_len > 0)
436: 			memcpy(rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_len);
437: 
438: 		ret_val = BK_OK;
439: 
440: 	}while(0);
441: 
442: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
443: 
444: 	rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
445: 
446: 	return ret_val;
447: 
448: }

515: static u32 ipc_cmd_handler(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)
516: {
517: 	/* must NOT change ack_buf->hdr. */
518: 
519: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
520: 	ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
521: 
522: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
523: 
524: 	ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff;
525: 
526: 	switch(chnl_cb->rx_cmd)
527: 	{
528: 		case IPC_RES_AVAILABLE_INDICATION:
529: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u16))
530: 			{
531: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
532: 
533: 				u16  res_id = *((u16 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf);
534: 
535: 				if(amp_res_available(res_id) == BK_OK)
536: 				{
537: 					result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
538: 				}
539: 				else
540: 				{
541: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
542: 				}
543: 			}
544: 			else
545: 			{
546: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
547: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
548: 			}
549: 			break;
550: 
551: 		case IPC_TEST_CMD:
552: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u32))
553: 			{
554: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
555: 
556: 				u32 * p_src = (u32 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
557: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
558: 
559: 				*p_dst = (*p_src) + 1;
560: 				
561: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
562: 			}
563: 			else
564: 			{
565: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
566: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
567: 			}
568: 			break;
569: 
570: 		case IPC_GET_POWER_SAVE_FLAG:
571: 			{
572: 				// return PS flag to caller.
573: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
574: 
575: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
576: 
577: 				mb_ipc_get_power_save_state(p_dst);
578: 
579: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
580: 			}
581: 			break;
582: 
583: #if (USB_CDC_CP1_IPC)
584: 		case IPC_CPU0_START_USB_CDC:
585: 			{
586: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
587: 				bk_usb_cdc_start();
588: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
589: 			}
590: 			break;
591: 
592: 		case IPC_CPU0_CLOSE_USB_CDC:
593: 			{

114: static int ipc_heartbeat_timeout(void)
115: {
116: 	u32   cur_time;
117: 
118: 	cur_time = (u32)rtos_get_time();
119: 
120: 	if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
121: 	{
122: 		return 0;
123: 	}
124: 	if((cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING) || (cpu_x_dump != 0))
125: 	{
126: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = cur_time;
127: 		return 0;
128: 	}
129: 
130: 	if(cur_time >= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)
131: 	{
132: 		cur_time -= cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp;
133: 	}
134: 	else
135: 	{
136: 		cur_time += (~(cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp)) + 1;  // wrap around.
137: 	}
138: 
139: 	if(cur_time < HB_TIMEOUT_MS)
140: 	{
141: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
142: 		return 0;
143: 	}
144: 
145: 	if (bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_get(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT))
146: 	{
147: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
148: 		bk_pm_module_lv_sleep_state_clear(PM_DEV_ID_DEFAULT);
149: 		return 0;
150: 	}
151: 
152: 	if(s_mb_ipc_work_state == MB_IPC_EXIT_LV)
153: 	{
154: 		cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp = (u32)rtos_get_time();
155: 		s_mb_ipc_work_state = MB_IPC_WORKING;
156: 		return 0;
157: 	}
158: 
159: 	return 1;
160: }

220: static void mb_ipc_task( void *para )
221: {
222: 	bk_err_t	ret_val;
223: 	u32    events;
224: 	u32    check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
225: 
226: 	mb_ipc_init_lv_callback();
227: 
228: 	ret_val = rtos_init_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event);
229: 
230: 	if(ret_val != BK_OK)
231: 	{
232: 		rtos_delete_thread(NULL);
233: 		return;
234: 	}
235: 
236: 	while(1)
237: 	{
238: 		events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_ALL_FLAGS, true, check_time);
239: 
240: 		if(events == 0)
241: 		{
242: 			// timeout, so check heartbeat.
243: 			events = MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG;
244: 		}
245: 
246: 		if(events & MB_IPC_STOP_CORE_FLAG)  // process this event at first!!!!
247: 		{
248: 			if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
249: 			{
250: 				events = 0;  // clear all events.
251: 			}
252: 		}
253: 		
254: 		if(events & MB_IPC_START_CORE_FLAG)
255: 		{
256: 			u8   retry_cnt = 0;
257: 
258: 			while(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
259: 			{
260: 				ipc_heartbeat_timeout();
261: 				
262: 				if(events & MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG)
263: 				{
264: 					if(cpu_x_state == CORE_STARTING)
265: 					{
266: 						cpu_x_state = CORE_POWER_ON;
267: 						break;  // cpu1 power on. 
268: 					}
269: 				}
270: 				else
271: 				{
272: 					if( retry_cnt > 3)
273: 					{
274: 						BK_DUMP_OUT("IPC retry to start core%d, retry_cnt:%d\r\n", cpu_x_id, retry_cnt);
275: 						// restart_cpu_x();
276: 						break;
277: 					}
278: 					else
279: 					{
280: 						events = rtos_wait_event_ex(&mb_ipc_heart_event, MB_IPC_POWER_UP_FLAG, true, 2000);//2s
281: 					}
282: 				}
283: 
284: 				retry_cnt++;
285: 			}
286: 
287: 			// discard this event when not in CORE_STARTING state.
288: 		}
289: 		
290: 		if(events & MB_IPC_HEARTBEAT_FLAG)
291: 		{
292: 			if(ipc_heartbeat_timeout())
293: 			{
294: 				BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "IPC[%d]heartbeat timeout %d,%d\r\n",cpu_x_id,cpu_x_heartbeat_timestamp,(u32)rtos_get_time());
295: 				/*when cpu1 heartbeat timeout, then system reboot*/
296: 				cpu_x_heartbeat_timeout = 1;
297: 				ap_console_bridge_link_down();
298: 				BK_ASSERT(false);
299: 			}
300: 		}
301: 
302: 		if(cpu_x_state == CORE_POWER_OFF)
303: 		{
304: 			check_time = BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER;
305: 		}
306: 		else
307: 		{
308: 			check_time = HB_TIMEOUT_MS;
309: 		}
310: 	}
311: }

331: static void pm_module_bootup_cpu1(pm_power_module_name_e module)
332: {
333: 	uint64_t previous_tick = 0;
334: 	uint64_t current_tick   = 0;
335: 	if(PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF == sys_drv_module_power_state_get(module))
336: 	{
337: 		if(module == PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1)
338: 		{
339: boot_cp1:
340: 			#if CONFIG_PM_AP_POWERDOWN_WHEN_LV
341: 			bk_pm_module_vote_sleep_ctrl(PM_SLEEP_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, 0, 0);
342: 			#endif
343:             bk_pm_module_vote_power_ctrl(PM_POWER_MODULE_NAME_CPU1, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
344: 
345: 			#if defined(RECV_LOG_FROM_MBOX)
346: 			void reset_forward_log_status(void);
347: 			// reset cpu1's log transfer status on cpu0.
348: 			reset_forward_log_status();
349: 			#endif
350: 
351:             start_cpu1_core();
352: 
353: 			previous_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
354: 			current_tick = previous_tick;
355: 			while((current_tick - previous_tick) < (PM_BOOT_CP1_WAITING_TIEM*AON_RTC_MS_TICK_CNT))
356: 			{
357: 				if (bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get()) // wait the cp1 response
358: 				{
359: 					break;
360: 				}
361: 				current_tick = bk_aon_rtc_get_current_tick(AON_RTC_ID_1);
362: 			}
363: 
364: 			if(!bk_pm_cp1_work_state_get())
365: 			{
366: 				BK_LOGD(NULL,"cp0 boot cp1[%d] time out, boot cp1 fail!!!\r\n",s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count);
367: 
368: 				/*Reset psram*/
369: 				bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_MEDIA, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF);
370: 				bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_MEDIA, PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON);
371: 
372: 				s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count++;
373: 				if(s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count < PM_BOOT_CP1_TRY_COUNT)
374: 				{
375: 					goto boot_cp1;
376: 				}
377: 				if(s_pm_cp1_boot_try_count == PM_BOOT_CP1_TRY_COUNT)
378: 				{
379: 					#if CONFIG_WDT_EN
380: 					bk_wdt_force_reboot();//try 3 times, if fail ,reboot.
381: 					#endif
382: 				}
383: 			}
384: 		}
385: 	}
